seo.title: Cylinder Volume Calculator - Tank Volume
seo.description: Cylinder Volume Calculator — Calculate the volume of a cylinder in liters, m³, or gallons from diameter and height with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: V = π(D/2)² × H. Dimensions in m after conversion; ×1000 converts m³ to liters.

content.introduction: Calculate the internal volume of a cylinder — the basis for tank volume, pipe capacity, and pressure vessel calculations. For horizontal tanks, use the tank volume calculator for partially-filled volumes.

example.description: 3m diameter × 6m tall cylinder = 42,412 liters (same as our vertical tank example).

faq.q: How do I convert liters to gallons?
faq.a: 1 liter = 0.264 US gallons = 0.22 UK gallons. Divide liters by 3.785 for US gallons.

faq.q: Does this work for horizontal tanks?
faq.a: This gives total (100% full) volume. For partially-filled horizontal tanks, use the liquid-volume calculator which accounts for fill height.
